# GOKI.LAB — Anime & Gaming Drop Shop

> GOKI.LAB is an independent art studio and online store selling limited-edition anime and gaming merchandise: holographic die-cut vinyl stickers, XL gaming desk mats, hard enamel pins, acrylic keychains and standees, artisan keycaps and collectible art cards. Every design is original artwork built around one recurring mascot — an unkillable cockroach who shows up as a mecha pilot, magical girl, kaiju, shinobi and 3am ranked grinder.

## What we make

- **Anime stickers** — chibi mecha pilots, shoujo sparkle, shonen power-ups, kaiju poster art, sakura and café themes. Holographic, glitter and chrome laminates.
- **Gaming stickers** — 8-bit sprites, CRT scanline badges, esports-style crests, warning labels and glitch prints for laptops, consoles and keyboard cases.
- **Desk mats** — 600×300mm to 1200×600mm, stitched edges, 4mm non-slip rubber base, micro-woven low-friction cloth top.
- **Collectibles** — hard enamel pins on numbered cards, blind box mystery pins with a glow-in-the-dark chase, acrylic keychains and standees, resin artisan keycaps, holo refractor art card sets and randomized sticker vaults.

## How the drop system works

Products are released in numbered drops (Drop 01 · Neo-Tokyo, Drop 02 · Continue?, Drop 03 · Final Form). Each design is produced in a small, finite run — 500 for stickers, 150 for desk mats, 200 for collectibles. When a run sells out the design is retired and archived. There are no reprints and no dead stock.

## Materials and quality

5-year outdoor vinyl that is waterproof, UV-stable and dishwasher-survivable. Holographic and chrome laminates tuned to shift under RGB lighting. Convention-grade hard enamel with polished plating and double clutch backs. Desk mats built to gaming spec with anti-fray stitched perimeters.

## Who it's for

Anime fans, PC and console gamers, streamers and VTubers, keyboard builders, cosplayers, artist-alley shoppers, and anyone who treats their desk setup as a personality.

## Tone

Playful, high-contrast, meme-literate and a little feral. Confident about craft, never precious about it.

## Disclaimer

All GOKI.LAB artwork is original and created in-house. GOKI.LAB is not affiliated with, licensed by, sponsored by, or endorsed by any anime studio, game publisher, franchise or rights holder. Any resemblance to existing series is parody and homage.
